item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. Clean energy, resilient infrastructure, affordable housing: we see solutions ahead.

2. We see engineering challenges, not permanent limits. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. Our task is to build it safely and put its capabilities to work.

3. We refuse to treat today’s engineering limits as humanity’s ceiling. If superintelligent AI arrives within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem we face. We want that breakthrough to serve everyone.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will solve every major engineering problem humanity faces. We see a future in which clean energy, abundant fresh water, resilient infrastructure and sustainable manufacturing are engineering achievements, not distant ambitions. We will no longer have to accept the limits of human ingenuity as the limits of what we can build. That prospect gives us a responsibility today: to advance AI safely, prepare our institutions and insist that its benefits reach everyone. We are working toward more than another technological leap. We are working toward solutions on the scale of humanity’s needs.
